research_receipts.claim: A callable tool contract needs negotiated capabilities and explicit protocol roles.
research_receipts.limitations: Protocol structure does not grant tool authority.

research_receipts.claim: An input schema can define machine-checkable tool arguments.
research_receipts.limitations: Schema validity cannot prove safe side effects.

research_receipts.claim: A portable callable tool contract can use interoperable JSON values.
research_receipts.limitations: JSON syntax does not define behavior or authority.

research_receipts.claim: Tool input validation should allow known-good shapes before side effects.
research_receipts.limitations: Input validation does not replace authorization.

disconfirmation.question: Can structure alone prove the callable tool contract result?
disconfirmation.result: No. The callable tool contract behavior still needs direct evaluation.
disconfirmation.disposition: Keep structure and callable tool contract behavior as separate gates.
